notes.title: CLARITY UPDATE and MINOR BUG FIX!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We've gone ahead and tried to make things a bit more clear.
-Checkpoints are now labeled as a "CHECKPOINT"
-Work prisoners have been labeled "REBEL."

We've also added arrows for "Pickup and Return" missions to help direct the player to where they need to go.

Lastly, in the upgrade menus, we've added a glow to the down arrow to show that there are more upgrades/badges to explore.

We hope this helps make the game a bit more clear and more enjoyable to play!

We also fixed a bug that was caused by the previous update, which would not let the player continue on transport missions.

Have a great day everyone!

notes.title: Full Controller Support for all 4 players!
notes.notes: After a few long nights, we've updated the game with full controller support for all 4 players! Keyboard play is completely optional now.
